next_step: Closed-lost: required EU-only hosting not supported by Redwood hosted regions; competitor offered EU-only tenancy. Capture loss reasons, close opportunity.
notes:
Pipeline notes and call summaries:
- 2024-09-15 inbound demo request (sec/compliance team). AE assigned: Jamie Park.
- 2024-09-30 discovery call w/ CTO (Lena Müller), Head of Security (Marco Diaz). Basic ask: EU-only residency for transaction data + bring-your-own-KMS.
- 2024-10-03 PoC scope agreed: small batch reranking + embeddings for chargeback detection. 6-week POC.
- 2024-10-21 technical deep-dive with SE (Priya). Verified latency SLOs, throughput targets: 5k qps ephemeral, 50ms p95 for chat flows.
- 2024-10-28 legal sent data residency questionnaire; required contract language for EU-only processing and keys to remain in EU.
- 2024-11-02 update: security team rejected hosted variant; asked for isolated EU tenancy + HSM in EU region.
- 2024-11-08 competing vendor (EU-CloudAI) presented EU-only managed tenant + EU KMS offering. Equinox leaned toward competitor.
- 2024-11-15 internal budget reallocation flagged; PO delayed pending procurement sign-off.
- 2024-11-20 AE notes: deal moving to closed-lost — Redwood cannot currently offer customer-isolated EU-only region + EU KMS requirement. No CSM assigned.
Key quotes: "We simply cannot have tokens or embeddings leave the EU perimeter — regulator will not allow it." — Lena Müller (CTO).
Stakes: high (payments, regulated data). Main reasons lost: data residency platform limitation + competitor product fit + lack of exec champion after legal pushback.
Next actions for team: record technical requirements in loss review doc, add feature request for EU-only tenancy + KMS integration, mark contact stale, salvage POC artifacts (security FAQ, latency bench) for future re-engagement if product changes.
loss_reason_summary: Regulatory requirement for EU-only hosting and EU KMS; Redwood hosted regions did not provide customer-isolated EU tenancy or EU HSM solution at time of evaluation. Competitor offered EU-only managed tenant and won RFP.
